ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53386  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Mobility, Ports, and Infrastructure
  Committee meeting held Tuesday, November 14, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53394  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Harbor Department
  and the Alameda Corridor Transportation Authority (ACTA) on the Port of Long

CALL TO ORDER

At 2:32 PM, Chair Saro called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Councilmembers Present: Kerr, Saro

Councilmembers Absent: Austin

Also present: Eric Lopez, Director of Public Works, Vanessa Ibarra, Deputy City Attorney,
Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst.

Chair Saro spoke.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53386  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Mobility, Ports, and Infrastructure
  Committee meeting held Tuesday, November 14, 2023.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Kerr, seconded by Chair Saro, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Kerr, Saro
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Austin

2.  24-53394  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Harbor Department
  and the Alameda Corridor Transportation Authority (ACTA) on the Port of Long
  Beach Pier B Rail Facility and Alameda Corridor Project.

  A motion was made by Chair Saro, seconded by Vice Chair Kerr, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2 Kerr, Saro
